data.description:
## What
Implement overlay dispatch in `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py`:
1. Add `_build_overlay_agents(classification, diff_text, config_path)` — reads overlay flags, builds agent descriptors
2. Add `_overlay_agents_from_findings(findings_list)` — inspects tier findings summaries for `*_overlay_warranted: yes` fields
3. Update `main()` to concatenate tier + overlay agents and dispatch in parallel (initial pass), then run serial second pass if warranted overlays detected

## Selected approach (Proposal 2 from approach-decision-maker)
- `_build_agents_for_tier` stays focused on tier logic; remove ARG001 annotation from classification param
- `_build_overlay_agents` builds overlay agents by checking `classification['security_overlay']`, `classification['performance_overlay']`, `classification['test_quality_overlay']`
- Overlay agent IDs: `code-reviewer-security-red-team`, `code-reviewer-performance`, `code-reviewer-test-quality`
- All agents dispatched via single `async_dispatch_specialists` call (parallel)
- Serial fallback: `_overlay_agents_from_findings(findings_list)` scans each finding dict's 'summary' field for patterns like `security_overlay_warranted: yes`, `performance_overlay_warranted: yes`, `test_quality_overlay_warranted: yes`; returns list of agent descriptors for any warranted overlays NOT already in the initial dispatch set
- Second pass uses same `async_dispatch_specialists`; does NOT inspect second-pass findings for further warranted flags (one pass only)

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py
  - `_build_agents_for_tier`: remove ARG001 annotation (classification used downstream now)
  - Add `_build_overlay_agents(classification, diff_text, config_path)` private function
  - Add `_overlay_agents_from_findings(findings_list)` private function
  - `main()`: combine tier+overlay agents before dispatch; add serial fallback second pass

## Acceptance Criteria
- `python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py::test_overlay_agents_dispatched_in_parallel_when_flagged_by_classifier` passes
- `python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py::test_overlay_warranted_fallback_dispatched_serially` passes
- `ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py` exits 0
- No new ruff violations introduced

## Testing Mode
GREEN — makes RED tests from 3c18-91b8 and a643-4a2a pass

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py (modify)
data.title: GREEN: runner.py — add _build_overlay_agents and _overlay_agents_from_findings, wire overlay dispatch in main()
